paragraphs.en: Next generation e2e testing framework for web and mobile apps.
paragraphs.zh: 下一代 Web 与移动应用端到端（e2e）测试框架。

paragraphs.en: e2e is an end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps. Describe a goal in natural language and an agent drives the app to reach it. Check the result with locators and assertions in the same test.
paragraphs.zh: e2e 是一个面向网页和移动应用的端到端测试框架。 用自然语言描述一个目标，智能体便会驱动应用去实现它。 在同一个测试中，使用定位器和断言来检查结果。

sents.en: e2e is an end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps.
sents.zh: e2e 是一个面向网页和移动应用的端到端测试框架。

sents.en: Describe a goal in natural language and an agent drives the app to reach it.
sents.zh: 用自然语言描述一个目标，智能体便会驱动应用去实现它。

sents.en: Check the result with locators and assertions in the same test.
sents.zh: 在同一个测试中，使用定位器和断言来检查结果。

paragraphs.en: // tests/checkout.e2e.ts import { test , expect } from 'e2e' ; test ( 'a member upgrades to Pro' , async ( { app , agent , screen } ) => { await app . open ( '/settings/billing' ) ; await agent . act ( 'upgrade the workspace to the Pro plan' ) ; await agent . assert ( 'the invoice preview shows a prorated amount' ) ; await expect ( screen . getByRole ( 'status' ) ) . toContainText ( 'Pro' ) ; } ) ; An agent step that a later assertion verifies records its actions, and the next run replays them with no model calls until the app changes. Tests without agent steps need no model. Bring your own subscription, API key, or local model.
paragraphs.zh: // tests/checkout.e2e.ts import { test , expect } from 'e2e' ; test ( '成员升级到 Pro' , async ( { app , agent , screen } ) => { await app . open ( '/settings/billing' ) ; await agent . act ( '把工作区升级到 Pro 计划' ) ; await agent . assert ( '发票预览显示按比例计算的金额' ) ; await expect ( screen . getByRole ( 'status' ) ) . toContainText ( 'Pro' ) ; } ) ; 智能体步骤会被记录其操作，后续断言可据此验证，下一次运行时在应用未变更的情况下无需调用模型即可回放这些操作。 不含智能体步骤的测试无需模型。 可自带订阅、API 密钥或本地模型。

sents.en: // tests/checkout.e2e.ts import { test , expect } from 'e2e' ; test ( 'a member upgrades to Pro' , async ( { app , agent , screen } ) => { await app . open ( '/settings/billing' ) ; await agent . act ( 'upgrade the workspace to the Pro plan' ) ; await agent . assert ( 'the invoice preview shows a prorated amount' ) ; await expect ( screen . getByRole ( 'status' ) ) . toContainText ( 'Pro' ) ; } ) ; An agent step that a later assertion verifies records its actions, and the next run replays them with no model calls until the app changes.
sents.zh: // tests/checkout.e2e.ts import { test , expect } from 'e2e' ; test ( '成员升级到 Pro' , async ( { app , agent , screen } ) => { await app . open ( '/settings/billing' ) ; await agent . act ( '把工作区升级到 Pro 计划' ) ; await agent . assert ( '发票预览显示按比例计算的金额' ) ; await expect ( screen . getByRole ( 'status' ) ) . toContainText ( 'Pro' ) ; } ) ; 智能体步骤会被记录其操作，后续断言可据此验证，下一次运行时在应用未变更的情况下无需调用模型即可回放这些操作。

sents.en: Tests without agent steps need no model.
sents.zh: 不含智能体步骤的测试无需模型。

sents.en: Bring your own subscription, API key, or local model.
sents.zh: 可自带订阅、API 密钥或本地模型。

paragraphs.en: npx e2e init init asks for an engine, web or mobile, and a model provider, then writes a config and an example test. The quickstart covers the rest.
paragraphs.zh: npx e2e init 会先询问引擎（web 或 mobile）以及模型提供方，然后写入一份配置和一个示例测试。 快速上手指南涵盖了其余内容。

sents.en: npx e2e init init asks for an engine, web or mobile, and a model provider, then writes a config and an example test.
sents.zh: npx e2e init 会先询问引擎（web 或 mobile）以及模型提供方，然后写入一份配置和一个示例测试。
快速上手指南涵盖了其余内容。

paragraphs.en: To see a finished setup in your stack, open examples/ : Vite, Next.js, Astro, Expo, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Multiplatform, Flutter, and .NET MAUI, each a standalone project with a passing suite.
paragraphs.zh: 要在您的技术栈中查看完整的配置示例，请打开 examples/ 目录：Vite、Next.js、Astro、Expo、SwiftUI、Jetpack Compose、Kotlin Multiplatform、Flutter 和 .NET MAUI，每个都是独立的独立项目，且都带有可全部通过的测试套件。

paragraphs.en: e2e.tester.army/docs . The e2e package ships every page, so coding agents can read them offline in node_modules/e2e/docs .
paragraphs.zh: e2e.tester.army/docs 。 e2e 包附带每一页文档，因此编码智能体可以在 node_modules/e2e/docs 中离线阅读它们。

sents.en: The e2e package ships every page, so coding agents can read them offline in node_modules/e2e/docs .
sents.zh: e2e 包附带每一页文档，因此编码智能体可以在 node_modules/e2e/docs 中离线阅读它们。

paragraphs.en: See CONTRIBUTING.md . Questions go to Discord .
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md 。 问题请前往 Discord 提出。

sents.zh: 问题请前往 Discord 提出。

paragraphs.en: Please don't open public issues for security vulnerabilities. Follow SECURITY.md and report them to security@tester.army .
paragraphs.zh: 请不要在公开议题中报告安全漏洞。 请遵循 SECURITY.md 并将漏洞报告至 security@tester.army 。

sents.en: Please don't open public issues for security vulnerabilities.
sents.zh: 请不要在公开议题中报告安全漏洞。

sents.en: Follow SECURITY.md and report them to security@tester.army .
sents.zh: 请遵循 SECURITY.md 并将漏洞报告至 security@tester.army 。

paragraphs.en: The CLI sends anonymous usage data, such as which commands and engines run and where runs fail, but no test content, app content, or credentials. Opt out with npx e2e telemetry disable or E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 . Telemetry lists every field.
paragraphs.zh: CLI 会发送匿名使用数据，例如运行了哪些命令和引擎、运行在何处失败，但不会发送测试内容、应用内容或凭据。 可通过 npx e2e telemetry disable 或 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 选择退出。 遥测页面列出了每个字段。

sents.zh: 可通过 npx e2e telemetry disable 或 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 选择退出。

paragraphs.en: e2e is in active development on the way to 1.0. APIs and config can still change between minor releases.
paragraphs.zh: e2e 正在积极开发中，朝着 1.0 版本迈进。 API 和配置在次要版本之间仍可能发生变更。

sents.zh: API 和配置在次要版本之间仍可能发生变更。

paragraphs.en: e2e is built by TesterArmy , the agentic testing platform that runs natural language tests on web and mobile apps, on every pull request or on a schedule.
paragraphs.zh: e2e 由 TesterArmy 打造，这是一个智能体测试平台，可在每次拉取请求时或按计划对 Web 和移动应用运行自然语言测试。
